texts.close_hint: Izinsuku ezingama-30 zokushintsha umqondo. I-LynkID yakho ayisoze yanikezwa omunye umuntu.
texts.close_requested: Izovalwa ngo-{when}. Ngena ngaphambi kwalokho ukuze uyigcine.
texts.contact_hint: Sithumele ikhodi enezinombolo ezi-6. Iphelelwa yisikhathi ngemizuzu eyi-10.
texts.download_hint: Kuzolunga ezinsukwini ezingama-30, bese kutholakala izinsuku eziyi-7.
texts.help_article_1: Ulahlekelwe yifoni? Indlela ukubuyisa okusebenza ngayo
texts.keep_one_passkey: Gcina okungenani ukhiye wokungena owodwa. Engeza omunye ngaphambi kokususa lo.
texts.last_owner_note: Umnikazi wokugcina akakwazi ukuhamba. Qala ngokudlulisela ubunikazi.
texts.memberships_body: Ubulungu be-LynkBooking ne-LynkEssential buzovela lapha uma ujoyina.
texts.never_allowed: Neze: i-SMS iyodwa, imibuzo yokuphepha, ukusetha kabusha ngocingo, i-imeyili iyodwa.
texts.notice_consent: Ukwabelana nomgcinimabhuku wakho kuphela ezinsukwini eziyi-7
texts.overview_security_ok: Ukuphepha: okhiye bokungena abangu-{n}, ikhodi yokubuyisa isethiwe
texts.passkey_hint: Ukhiye wokungena uthatha indawo yephasiwedi. Engeza owodwa kule divayisi manje; engeza idivayisi yesibili maduze.
texts.path_assisted_body: Umazisi, ubufakazi bebhizinisi nokuhlolwa okubukhoma. Bese ulinda amahora angama-72 nemvume yabasebenzi ababili. Akusoze kwenziwa ngocingo.
texts.path_code_body: Faka womabili amakhodi. Bese ulinda amahora angama-24: yonke idivayisi ebhalisiwe nomxhumani wakho wesipele bayaziswa, futhi noma ubani wabo angakukhansela.
texts.path_device_body: Vula i-LynkOmni kwenye idivayisi bese uvuma nge-PIN yayo. Ubuyela ngaphakathi ngokushesha.
texts.payslips_empty: Awekho amaslibhu omholo okwamanje. Azovela lapha uma umqashi ekukhokhela nge-LynkOmni.
texts.recover_question_device: Unayo enye ifoni noma ikhompyutha ongene kuyo?
texts.recovery_cancel_note: Noma iyiphi idivayisi ebhalisiwe noma umxhumani wakho wesipele angakhansela lokhu.
texts.recovery_code_hint: Iboniswa kanye kuphela. Yibhale ephepheni uyigcine kude nefoni yakho. Ayisoze ithunyelwe kuwe futhi.
texts.recovery_code_push: Okulandelayo: bhalisa idivayisi yesibili noma umnikazi ohlanganyele namuhla. Yiyona ndlela esheshayo yokubuya.
texts.recovery_restricted: Ngemva kokubuyisa, le divayisi ikhawulelwe amahora angama-24: azikho izinguquko zendima noma zokukhokhwa, akukho ukususa amanye amadivayisi, akukho ukukhipha idatha.
texts.screens_hint: Khetha isikrini. Ukubhalisa, ukungena nokubuyisa kulandela imithetho okuvunyelwene ngayo: okhiye bokungena kuqala, i-SMS iyodwa ayisoze yanela, isikhathi sokulinda abantu abangasikhansela.
texts.security_always: Izexwayiso zokuphepha zihlala zifika, ngaphandle kwezixhumanisi.
texts.sf_age: Isitolo se-inthanethi esabantu abaneminyaka engu-{age} noma ngaphezulu, noma abasebadala ngokomthetho lapho behlala khona.
texts.sf_identity_why: Ngaphambi kokunikezwa kwakho kokuqala okukhokhelwayo, umlingani wokukhokha onelayisensi uhlola ukuthi ungubani. Okunikezwa mahhala kungafakwa ngaphandle kwalokho.
texts.sf_intro: Nikeza imikhiqizo yakho, izinsiza, izifundo noma amafayela kubo bonke futhi ukhokhelwe ngabalingani bokukhokha abanelayisensi. Isitolo sakho se-inthanethi sisebenzisa le akhawunti efanayo.
texts.sf_plan_line: {plan}: {share} kokuthengiswa ngakunye esitolo se-inthanethi, kuthathwa ngumlingani wokukhokha
texts.signin_hint: I-akhawunti eyodwa yazo zonke izindawo ze-LynkOmni.
texts.signin_new_device_note: Idivayisi noma indawo entsha? Sikwazisa kuyo yonke imigudu, ngaphandle kwesixhumanisi emlayezweni.
texts.signin_passkey_hint: Ifoni noma ikhompyutha yakho iqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe. Ayikho iphasiwedi okufanele uyikhumbule.
texts.signup_adult: Ngineminyaka engu-{age} noma ngaphezulu, noma sengimdala ngokomthetho lapho ngihlala khona
texts.standing_intro: Inkokhelo emisiwe ingumyalelo wakho: umkhawulo owusethayo, ogcinwa ngumhlinzeki onelayisensi, futhi uyaziswa njalo uma usetshenziswa.
texts.start_intro: Bhalisa ibhizinisi, thola inombolo yentela futhi uvule i-akhawunti yebhange yebhizinisi ngesango likahulumeni namabhange ezweni lakho. Kumahhala kuwe; izimali zikahulumeni ziya ngqo kuhulumeni.
texts.start_not_before: Akukho okuvunyiwe kuze kube iziphathimandla zisho njalo.
texts.start_submitted: Kuthunyelwe. Iziphathimandla yizo ezinquma; sizobonisa impendulo yazo lapha.
texts.stepup_hint: Kudingeka ukuhlola okusha kwalokhu. Faka ikhodi esiyithumele.
texts.support_side_note: Imibuzo ngokuthengisa, okunikezwayo, abathengi nokukhokhelwa iya osizweni lwabathengisi. Okubalulekile kwakho kuphezulu kunazo zonke izinhlelo zakho.
texts.username_change_note: Igama lakho lomsebenzisi elidala liyaqhubeka likhomba kuwe futhi alisoze laya komunye umuntu.
texts.wallet_empty: Isikhwama sakho asinalutho. Amathikithi, amavawusha, amakhodi e-eSIM namaphuzu avela kuzo zonke izitolo azovela lapha.
texts.ws_help: Izincwadi, ama-invoyisi, oxhumana nabo nemibiko efanayo yakho, yenkampani noma yenhlangano.
texts.ws_note: Amanani nemithetho efanayo kubo bonke. Akudingeki idivayisi.
